_comment: How rare each minifigure's bag and parts are (edited by hand; loot.rs). A dropped part or bag is a minifigure of the world it drops in (data/minifigure_drops.json), picked with the weight of its tier; minifigures not listed have the default tier. A part's location is then picked with the location weights. The live tiers are unknown: the names and weights here are placeholders (the client's Collection texts have 'Rare' and 'Epic').
